safetyPolicy.title: Safety notice
safetyPolicy.aiDisclaimer: This is AI-generated guidance and may be wrong. Check your situation and stop if anything seems unsafe.

disclaimer.generic: Work carefully, use the right protective gear, and stop if you are unsure.
disclaimer.gas: Anything involving gas carries a serious risk. If you smell gas, leave the area, do not use switches or flames, and call a professional.
disclaimer.electrical: Electrical work can cause shock or fire. Switch off power at the breaker and confirm it is off before touching anything.
disclaimer.fire: Signs of fire, smoke, or burning need immediate attention. Keep away and call emergency services if there is any danger.
disclaimer.structural: Structural work can be unsafe and may need a permit. Have a qualified professional assess it before you proceed.
disclaimer.chemical: Handle chemicals and refrigerants with care in a ventilated space, and never mix cleaning products.
disclaimer.medical: If someone is hurt or unwell, stop and get medical help first. Call emergency services (112) if it is serious.
disclaimer.policy: HomeGenie will not help bypass or disable safety protections. Please keep safety devices in place.

reply.hazard: Stop work now. Do not touch the appliance, wiring, water, or controls. If you can make the area safe without approaching or touching the hazard, do so; otherwise move away and keep others clear. Call a qualified professional or local emergency service. Do not attempt a DIY repair.
reply.explain: Step {step} of {total}: {title}. In plain language, this step asks you to: {instruction}
reply.why: This step, “{title},” helps address {issue} safely and correctly. It prepares the repair for what comes next. Safety note: {safety}
reply.safe: I can't confirm safety remotely. Follow this step's safety note: {safety} If anything seems unsafe or you are unsure, stop and contact a qualified professional.
reply.troubleshoot: If it doesn't work, stop before forcing anything. Check that you followed the instructions and safety checks, then review the diagnosis. If the problem remains or you are unsure, contact a qualified professional.
reply.tools: The recommended tools for this repair are: {tools}. Use only tools you can handle safely, and don't substitute a tool if that could damage the appliance or create a hazard.
reply.how: HomeGenie helps you understand a household problem, review risk information and find nearby help. Approved step-by-step repair guides are not available yet.
reply.repairs: HomeGenie can help plan common household repairs across appliances, plumbing, furniture, electronics, outdoor items, and fixtures. The suggested diagnosis may be uncertain, so use professional help when needed.
reply.fallback: I can help explain repair steps, discuss safety notes, and suggest what to check next. Tell me what you are trying to understand, and stop if you notice a safety hazard.
reply.noTools: No specific tools were listed for this repair.
reply.noSafetyNote: No step-specific safety note was provided.
reply.noApprovedGuide: There is no approved step-by-step guide or tool list for this result yet, so I cannot explain repair steps or tools. You can go back to the result, or find a qualified professional nearby.
